subject: general
question: In which of the following articles, “Protection against arrest and detention” is mentioned?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 22.**__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• Article 22 of the Indian constitution provides protection against arbitrary arrest and detention.__
 
• Though the police have been given various powers for facilitating the making of arrests, the powers are subject to certain restraints. 
 
• The accused in India are afforded certain rights in the Indian Constitution.
 
• One cannot be arrested and detained without being informed why he is being arrested.
 
• According to Article 22, an arrested person must be produced before the nearest magistrate within 24 hours of arrest.
 
• The arrested person has the right to be informed at the time of arrest of the offence for which the person is being arrested.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****Article 20** of the Indian Constitution provides protection against conviction for offences that were not considered an offence at the time of committing it.
 
• **Article 24 **prohibits the employment of children below the age of 14 years in factories, mines, and other hazardous occupations.
 
• ** Article 18** prohibits the State from conferring any titles other than military or academic distinctions, and the citizens of India cannot accept titles from a foreign state
